  • Methodendetails

    • InitOCRService

      @PostConstruct private void InitOCRService()
      Initializes the OCR service by setting up the Tesseract instance with the required data path, language, and DPI settings. This method is executed after dependency injection has completed.

    • GetTextFromPicture

      public RecipeDto GetTextFromPicture(String filepath) throws net.sourceforge.tess4j.TesseractException
      Extracts text from a given image file using OCR, processes it to extract the recipe information, including the title, ingredients, and instructions, and then creates a new recipe.
      Parameter:
      filepath - The path to the image file from which the text should be extracted.
      Gibt zurück:
      A RecipeDto object containing the recipe details (title, ingredients, and instructions).
      Löst aus:
      net.sourceforge.tess4j.TesseractException - If the OCR process encounters any errors during text extraction.

    • GetIngredients

      private ArrayList<IngredientDto> GetIngredients(String ocrString)
      Parses the provided OCR string to extract individual ingredients. It identifies the amount, unit, and name of each ingredient in the text.
      Parameter:
      ocrString - The string containing ingredient information extracted from OCR.
      Gibt zurück:
      A list of IngredientDto objects representing the ingredients with amount, unit, and name.
